rubric_items.reason: Uses only existing modules and symbols (PatientDetailPage, PatientService, AppointmentRepo, patientsRouter). It follows the routes/services/repositories layering. No new endpoint, table, migration or infrastructure.
The coverage map ties S-1 (incl. AC4 no date filter), S-2 (status filter, zero default) and S-3 (no other edits) to named components. Every story and criterion is served.
Method, path and field shape visit_summary {completed, no_show} are precise. The count types (integer, never null) and the service/repo method signatures are not stated.
Assumptions are labelled and backed by Q-01/Q-02. Some claims cite context files missing from the inputs list, and the claim that PatientFormPage ignores unknown fields has no citation.
Explains server-side vs client-side counting, a field on the existing response vs a new endpoint, snake_case naming and the logging impact, each with its cost.
Clear, consistent structure. Frontmatter and body agree on components, endpoints and status.
